title: OpenARM Follower Left Arm Factory Acceptance Report

summary.report_layout_policy: Page count and section count may expand with test scope; required evidence, measured data, readable headers, and deliverable factory formatting must be preserved.
summary.motor_serial_numbers: not_assigned; motors identified by joint label
summary.pdf_output_requirement: Chromium/Skia PDF; ReportLab fallback disabled for formal factory reports
summary.data_source_policy: strict_arm_serial_and_side; no global latest-job fallback; missing measured fields are reported as missing instead of being filled with fixed values

missing_required_data.detail: CAN health snapshot did not meet the active zero-error/zero-drop release criterion: state=ERROR-ACTIVE; bitrate=1000000; rx_errors=0; tx_errors=0; rx_dropped=0; tx_dropped=10.
missing_required_data.recommended_action: Reset or baseline the CAN counters, repeat the controlled communication test, and capture a clean same-serial CAN health snapshot.
